newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor futures fall steeply on selling.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor futures fall steeply on selling.

text.p: Castorseed June delivery fell sharply by 17 rupees to 1,112 rupees per quintal under speculative selling pressure, traders said.
They said arrivals of castorseed improved sharply while demand had not picked up as expected.
"Heavy arrivals triggered speculative selling," said a trader. On Friday, castorseed June delivery fell 11 rupees per quintal.
In edible oils, groundnut oil lost three rupees to 369 rupees per 10 kgs. In Rajkot, it was steady at 568 rupees per 15 kgs.
Imported palm oil gained a rupee to 295 rupees per kg.
